info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 Oidc API
APIs.io Engineering Platform Get the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Gets the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Set the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for an organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Creates or updates the customization template for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:org` scope to use this endpoint.
